notes.title: Dev Update!
notes.content: Hey all, sorry we've been silent for so long! We've just submitted another build to Steam. Since the Steam servers are having a hard time with the Summer Sale going on right now, we're not sure if this one will work for them or not - but it worked for us yesterday so it should! As soon as we know anything more, we'll comment on this thread!
